0022600033.text: The San Antonio Spurs (6-2, on a six-game winning streak and 2nd in the Southwest) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7, 15th in the West) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the ninth of the season for San Antonio. Tobias Harris and Jayden Quaintance are out for the Spurs, while Ben Simmons, Keegan Murray and Maxime Raynaud are out for the Kings, and De'Andre Hunter is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 130-103 win in San Antonio on October 27, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
